node.statement: Admissibility and the one-factor invariance estimate. Under the root hypotheses and 0 <= eta <= rho_3, all cited estimates below are applicable, Phi and Delta are UCP and hence completely contractive, tilde-Phi_n tilde-Delta_n=tilde-Delta_n, ||tilde-Delta||_cb <= 2, and for every amplification n and T in M_n(B), ||Phi_n(Delta_n T)-Delta_n T|| <= d||T|| with d:=2(C_theta+C_Delta)eta.
